_name: probe-2026-10-30-tcga-lineage - TCGA erlotinib, LUAD survival and the mapping link
_why: On 10-26 and 10-28 the unforced erlotinib question returned 0 (tasks 2586, 2829: T_D_SEQ required; TCGA holds sequencing as A.ALN; #143) and the survival question 201 (tasks 2585, 2830: patient-level fields); task 2834 named the method and got 513. Seven turns, one fresh chat each, PAID: needs the operator's go. Dev only.
_instance_warning: Dev only: TCGA is on dev, not on production. The numbers 54 and 513 were measured on dev on 10-28; the runner re-pins them on the box with pin_probe_truths.py.

cypher: MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'erlotinib' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n

MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'erlotinib' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n

MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'erlotinib' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n
MATCH (p:T_PAT) WHERE p.Study = 'TCGA-LUAD' AND p.VitalStatus IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(p) WHERE v.DaysToFollowUp IS NOT NULL } RETURN count(p) AS n
MATCH (p:T_PAT) WHERE p.Study = 'TCGA-LUAD' AND p.VitalStatus IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(p) WHERE v.DaysToFollowUp IS NOT NULL } RETURN count(p) AS n
